hero.subtitle: A grand celebration of student expression, cultural heritage, and the many vibrant colours that unite our motherland.

theme.description: Ek Bharat • Anek Rang is a tribute to India's timeless tapestry of regional languages, folk dances, musical traditions, and philosophical heritage. Through Tarang, our students weave these distinct threads into one harmonious celebration of unity.
theme.subtext: From the classical ragas of the north to the graceful abhinaya of the south, experience the civilizational spirit of togetherness.
